summary: FlowForge Phase 2 - Admin Approval System testing completed successfully. All 13 backend API tests passed (100%). All 9 frontend UI flows tested and working correctly. The complete approval workflow works: Create conversation -> AI generates workflow -> Submit for Approval -> Appears in queue -> Admin approves/rejects.

context_for_next_testing_agent: FlowForge Phase 2 (Admin Approval System) is complete and working. Key components: ApprovalQueue.jsx (queue UI), ApprovalDetailModal.jsx (detail view), FlowForgeChat.jsx (submit for approval flow), DashboardLayout.jsx (sidebar with approval link + badge). Backend routes in /app/backend/routers/flowforge.py lines 428-622. The approval workflow: Create conversation (/api/flowforge/conversations) -> Chat and generate workflow (/api/flowforge/generate) -> Submit approval (/api/flowforge/approvals) -> Admin reviews queue (/admin/approvals) -> Process action (/api/flowforge/approvals/{id}/action). Stats at /api/flowforge/approvals/stats.
